unauthorized: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
forbidden: You don't have access to this.
not_found: We couldn't find what you're looking for.
conflict: This was changed somewhere else at the same time. Refresh and try again.
validation: Some details aren't valid. Check them and try again.
module_disabled: This feature is turned off for this business.
rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
sole_owner: You are the only owner of a business that has other members. First make another member an owner, or remove the other members.
reauth_required: To keep your account safe, confirm it's you with the code we email you, then try again.
capability_disabled: This is turned off for your business. You can turn it on in Customize BizCost.
invitation_invalid: This invitation link doesn't work. It may have expired or been cancelled, or it was sent to another email. Ask for a new invitation.
already_member: This person is already a member of this business.
already_invited: This email already has an invitation waiting. You can send it again instead.
team_in_use: Your team still has members or invitations. Remove them first, then turn this off.
locations_in_use: Your business still has more than one branch. Remove the other branches first, then turn this off.
branch_limits_in_use: Some team members work only at some branches. In Team, let them work in every branch, or cancel their invitations, then turn this off.
owner_transfer_required: The owner can only change by transferring ownership.
default_location: This is your main branch. Make another branch the main one first.
only_location_of_products: Some products or services are sold only at this branch. In Products & Services, choose other branches for them first, then remove it.
only_branch_of_members: Some team members work only at this branch. In Team, change the branches they work in first, then remove it.
name_taken: You already have one with this name. Use another name, or find it in your list (archived ones too).
file_invalid: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image of up to 2 MB.
attachment_invalid: Use a photo (PNG, JPG or WebP) or a PDF of up to 10 MB.
books_closed: The books are closed up to this date. Use a later date, or open the books again in Settings.
future_date: This date is after today. Choose today or an earlier date.
document_posted: This is final and can't be changed. To fix it, reverse or correct it.
document_not_posted: This works only with a final document that wasn't reversed.
purchase_has_returns: This purchase has returns or credit notes. Reverse them first, then try again.
has_later_returns: The same goods have a later return that is still final. Reverse that return first, then try again.
exceeds_purchase: That's more than is left of this purchase. Check the quantity or the amount.
material_in_use: It is already used in purchases or products, so its kind of measure can't change. You can still pick another unit of the same kind.
unit_in_use: One of your products uses this in a pack or unit you took out or changed. Change what goes into it first, then try again.
payment_method_required: Choose how this purchase was paid, then try again.
purchase_has_payments: This purchase has payments recorded on it. Reverse the payments first, then try again.
exceeds_outstanding: That's more than is still owed. Check the amount.
expense_in_approval: This expense was sent for approval, so it can't be changed now. To change it, it must be rejected first.
expense_not_submitted: This expense wasn't sent for approval.
approval_required: This expense needs approval before it is final. Send it for approval instead.
approval_off: Expenses don't need approval now. Finalize it instead.
expense_has_payments: This expense has payments recorded on it. Reverse the payments first, then try again.
running_cost_choice_required: Say what this expense pays first: the bill of one of your running costs, or an extra expense. Then finalize it.
quotation_frozen: This quotation was sent, so it can’t be changed. Make a new revision instead.
quotation_superseded: A newer revision of this quotation exists. Open the latest one.
quotation_decided: The customer’s answer to this quotation is already recorded.
quotation_not_accepted: Mark the quotation as accepted first.
quotation_has_order: An order was already made from this quotation.
series_started: This series already has documents, so its first number can’t change.
sale_has_invoice: An issued invoice refers to this. To correct it, issue a credit note on the invoice.
details_missing: The tax invoice needs a few details first. Add what is missing, then issue it again.
exceeds_invoice: That's more than is left of this invoice to credit. Check the quantity or the amount.
quotation_invoiced: An invoice was already issued from this quotation, so it isn't made into an order. Invoice the rest from the quotation.
count_incomplete: Some items in this count aren't counted yet. Count them, or take them off the count, then finalize.
count_out_of_order: This count's day is too early: one of its items was counted on or after that day, or has entries after it. Start a count with a later day.
stock_tracked: You already track the stock of one of these items. Take it off this first count.
stock_not_tracked: You don't track the stock of one of these items yet, so this count can't include it. Take it off this count: tracking starts with a first count.
has_later_counts: One of these items was counted again after this count. Reverse that later count first, then try again.
stock_counted: One of these items was counted in a first count after this was recorded, so this can't be reversed now. Reverse that first count, then try again.
branch_has_stock: A branch you removed still has stock of one of these items, so its first count can't include it yet. Take that item off this first count for now.
stock_used_since: Stock of one of these items was taken out after this first count (for example, returned to a supplier). Reverse that first, then try again.
internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
network: Can't connect. Check your internet and try again.
last_channel: This is your only active sales channel. Add another channel first, then archive this one.
already_imported: This file was already imported. To bring it in again, reverse that import first.
import_unmatched: Some names in this file aren't settled yet. Match each one, add it as new, or mark it as not something you sell, then finalize.
import_replace_partial: A day you replace is part of an earlier file's sales of several days, and this file doesn't have all of them. Reverse that import first, or keep the days already imported.
statement_overlap: A final statement of this channel already covers some of these days. Reverse it first, or change the days.
sale_has_payments: This sale has payments recorded on it. Reverse the payments first, then try again.
sale_has_refunds: This sale has refunds. Reverse the refunds first, then try again.
exceeds_sale: That's more than is left of this sale to refund. Check the quantity or the amount.
order_cancelled: This order was cancelled, so it can't be changed, delivered or paid. Money given back is still recorded.
below_paid: The order's total can't be less than what the customer already paid. Give money back first, or keep the total.
payment_has_money_back: Money was given back to the customer from this payment. Reverse the money given back first, then the payment.

named.stock_tracked: Their stock is tracked already: {{names}}. Take them off this first count.
named.stock_not_tracked: Their stock isn't tracked yet: {{names}}. Take them off this count: tracking starts with a first count.
named.stock_counted: Counted in a first count after this was recorded: {{names}}. Reverse that first count first, then try again.
named.branch_has_stock: A branch you removed ({{names}}) still has stock of {{items}}, so this first count can't include them yet. Take them off this first count for now.
named.stock_used_since: Stock was taken out since this first count (for example, returned to a supplier): {{names}}. Reverse that first, then try again.
